The results text states that the 51/49 and Zn-doped samples display an ac (total) conductivity of 10−4 S/cm at 450 °C, measured in this work, and the 1150 °C / 3 h sintering applies to all samples.

The same sentence gives an ac conductivity of 10−4 S/cm at 450 °C for the 1% Zn-doped sample, which is measured in this paper and is total (ac) conductivity; the Zn dopant and the general sintering conditions match the paper.
